dossier_meta.context_text: Motivated by Harris's conjecture [27] that every triangle-free $d$-degenerate graph satisfies $\chi_f(G)\leq O(\frac{d}{\ln d})$ and by Molloy's bound $(1+o(1))\frac{\Delta(G)}{\ln\Delta(G)}$ in terms of the maximum degree. Since the spectral radius $\rho(G)$ is sandwiched between the degeneracy and the maximum degree, Theorem 1.6 of this paper (a new spectral upper bound on $\chi_f$) is presented as a first step toward interpolating between these two regimes.
